name: manual_d76bee
claim: Optional producer integration tests belong in the established optional or required interop lane, not the Phylax-free production test directory. Before publication test both modes, and assert that a missing required producer still fails rather than silently skipping.

decisions.notes: Closure Oramasys95: rich local suite passed while base CI found seven missing-Phylax fixture errors; 89da844c corrected test placement without adding production dependencies or weakening required-R3 collection.
